title: [yencoding] Fix pending-escape + dot-unstuffing wrong decoded byte
description: Skoll HIGH-52: When pending_escape is true on entry to decode_line and the line begins with '..' (NNTP dot-stuffing), dot-unstuffing fires first (stripping the first byte), then pending-escape consumes the second dot as the escape target, producing the wrong decoded byte. Fix: apply dot-unstuffing after resolving pending escape, not before. Also add test for pending-escape with entirely dot-stuffed framing line (MEDIUM-53).
close_reason: False positive from skoll. The current dot-unstuff-before-pending-escape order is correct: NNTP dot-stuffing is a transport-layer transformation that must be removed before content interpretation. Added explanatory comment and two tests (split escape with dot-stuffed target, split escape with all-framing line) confirming correct behavior.
